ko: 주를 찾는 모든 자들이 주로 말미암아
en: May all who seek the Lord my god through His wonderous Name
Rejoice and be glad in Him all our days

ko: 주의 구원을 사랑하는 자들이 항상 말하기를
en: May the ones who love saving help from You, Lord
proclaim this very thing That the Lord is great and mighty always forevermore

ko: 주는 나의 도움 나를 건지시는 이
en: You’re my help, deliverer and You have recued me
Lord, my God do not delay and come to my defense

ko: 가난 하고 궁핍한 내 마음 가운데
en: To my poor and needy heart
I ask that You would come
Lord my God, swiftly draw near to me
